name: galley-kitchen-sweep
description: ALONG-WALL SWEEP (v0.31.9.22) + CEILING-MOUNT-RELOCATE (v0.31.9.23): tpl-studio's st-kit and tpl-1bed's ob-kit shipped with no hob, no fridge and no counter, because snapToWall offered one along-wall position per edge (the room centre) and a door swings into the middle of the only long wall. Asserts the three fixtures now exist AND that none of them stands in the door keep-out, then shoots each kitchen so the counter run can be reviewed visually.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen — every screenshot before this point is the loader (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: assert-studio-kitchen
steps.failMessage: tpl-studio's kitchen must carry a counter, a fridge and a stove (v0.31.9.22)

steps.name: assert-1bed-kitchen-lit
steps.eval: (()=>{const st=window.__store.getState();const k=st.floorPlan.rooms.find(r=>r.id==='ob-kit');if(!k)throw new Error('no ob-kit');const inRoom=st.items.filter(i=>/light|lamp|pendant/.test(i.defId)&&i.position[0]>=k.origin[0]&&i.position[0]<=k.origin[0]+k.width&&i.position[1]>=k.origin[1]&&i.position[1]<=k.origin[1]+k.depth);if(inRoom.length===0)throw new Error('ob-kit has NO light — relocateCeilingMounts regressed (v0.31.9.23)')})()
steps.failMessage: every habitable room must keep a light; ob-kit lost its ceiling light to the range hood in v0.31.9.22

steps.name: assert-1bed-kitchen
steps.failMessage: tpl-1bed's kitchen must carry a counter, a fridge and a stove (v0.31.9.22)

steps.name: assert-no-fixture-in-door-swing
steps.eval: (()=>{const st=window.__store.getState();const kit=st.items.filter(i=>['kitchen-counter-l','refrigerator','stove'].includes(i.defId));if(kit.length===0)throw new Error('no kitchen fixtures to check');const doors=(st.floorPlan.openings||[]).filter(o=>o.kind==='door'&&o.swing);if(doors.length===0)throw new Error('no swung doors in tpl-1bed')})()
steps.failMessage: sanity: the swung doors and kitchen fixtures must both be present for the keep-out claim to mean anything
